content: The use of Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) is particularly advantageous for older adults, especially those diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. CGM systems assist in managing fluctuations in blood glucose levels and significantly reduce the risk of hypoglycemia. Advanced insulin delivery systems, such as automated insulin delivery (AID) devices and hybrid closed-loop systems, have demonstrated substantial efficacy in improving blood glucose management. These systems also minimize the duration of time patients spend in hypoglycemic states. Multiple clinical studies, including the WISDM (Wireless Innovations for Seniors with Diabetes Mellitus) and ORACL (Older Adults Receiving Automated Closed-Loop Therapy) trials, provide robust evidence supporting the effectiveness of these technologies in older adult populations.
